title: Car rental at Heathrow: a scenario comparison
standfirst: We compared SIXT and Enterprise for a one-day rental from Heathrow Terminal 2 to Canary Wharf. For this scenario, our recommendation is SIXT at £148.98.
author: The Gable Eye Editorial
affiliateDisclosure: The Gable Eye may earn a commission if you use some links on this page. Commercial relationships do not determine our recommendations.

recommendation.subject: SIXT
recommendation.reason: Lower scenario cost within the researched set.
recommendation.scenarioDisplay: Heathrow Terminal 2 → Canary Wharf / one-day rental

scenario.boundaryNote: This recommendation is limited to this pickup, drop-off and one-day rental scenario. It is not a claim about all Heathrow car-rental options.

atAGlance.heading: Our recommendation for this Heathrow rental scenario
atAGlance.body: For a one-day rental from Heathrow Terminal 2 to Canary Wharf, SIXT's scenario total was £148.98. Within the two providers researched for this exact comparison, that was the lower scenario cost.

comparedOptions.heading: The researched options
comparedOptions.introduction: These totals are limited to the supplied one-day Heathrow Terminal 2 to Canary Wharf scenario.

recommendationRationale.heading: A cost-led recommendation within the researched set
recommendationRationale.body: SIXT had the lower scenario cost within the two providers researched for this exact scenario. The authorised difference between the supplied scenario totals was £65.74.

methodology.heading: How we researched this comparison
methodology.body: We define the scenario, research provider and source evidence, verify accepted facts, compare relevant options, and make a recommendation only where the evidence supports it. The process includes human-supervised editorial review.
